cards.text: Cultivation +20, more with Insight. The bread and butter of the road.
Cultivation +30, more with Insight; restores 15% MP.
Cultivation +75, more with Insight. Costs an extra term of life. A one-in-five chance the heart-demon asks a question: a Dao-heart check.

pass.t: The demon speaks in your own voice. You do not answer, and it leaves. Dao-heart +1.

fail.t: The heart-demon wins the argument. You wake on the floor, bleeding from the nose.

cards.text: Cultivation +110, more with Insight. Costs an extra term of life. A one-in-seven chance of a Dao-heart check.

pass.t: The demon speaks in your own voice. You do not answer, and it leaves. Dao-heart +1.

fail.t: The heart-demon wins the argument. You wake on the floor, bleeding from the nose.

cards.text: Pay 5 HP. Cultivation +8; a 25% chance of Body +1.

fx.t: Something in the bone gives, and settles stronger.

cards.text: Pay 8 HP. Cultivation +16; a 35% chance of Body +1.

fx.t: Something in the bone gives, and settles stronger.

cards.text: Cultivation +8, MP +20%; a 25% chance of Spirit +1.

fx.t: The inner lake grows a little wider.

cards.text: Cultivation +14, MP +30%; a 35% chance of Spirit +1.

fx.t: The inner lake grows a little wider.

cards.text: Needs a sect library, a manual, or your own primer. Cultivation +14, more with Insight; a 20% chance of Insight +1.

fx.t: A line you have read ten times finally means something.

cards.text: Cultivation +14, more with Insight; +8 if any root is 3 or more; a quarter of the time the dawn is clear and gives +12 more.

fx.t: A clear dawn: the qi runs gold along the ridge.

cards.text: Cultivation +10, more with Insight. Teaches the Iron Fist technique. A 20% chance of Body +1.

fx.t: Your knuckles stop hurting. That is the same as getting stronger.

cards.text: Needs the Azure Sect or a metal root of 2. Cultivation +14, more with Insight; +8 with a metal root of 2; a 25% chance of Body, Spirit or Speed +1.
Cultivation +22, more with Insight; +12 with a metal root of 2; a 35% chance of Body, Spirit or Speed +1.
Cultivation +90, more with Insight, but Corruption +8, Notice +12 and you lose 15% HP. The Registry reads what is spilled.

fx.t: The rite takes more than it should, and gives more than you asked.

cards.text: The Azure Sect's signature form. Cultivation +50, more with Insight; +20 with a metal root of 3; a one-in-three chance of Spirit or Speed +1.
Cultivation +45, more with Insight; Corruption +4 and Notice +4. The Hall's quiet voice is very good at teaching.

fx.t: The whisper knows the next line of every page you have ever failed to understand.

cards.text: Pay 6 HP. Cultivation +12, more with Insight; a 50% chance of Body or Speed +1.
Pay 3 herbs. An Insight check (a wood root of 2 saves a herb): a pill fit for your realm; a perfect brew may be a breakthrough pill. Failure leaves ash.

then.t: A wood-root's knack: you save a herb from the pot.

fail.t: The furnace sputters. The herbs are ash and the pot smells of regret.

cards.text: Pay 3 herbs. An easier Insight check than Refine a Pill, with a better chance of a perfect brew.

then.t: A wood-root's knack: you save a herb from the pot.

fail.t: The nine heats fall out of step and the pill cracks. You keep the pieces, which is to say nothing.

cards.text: Pay 3 ore. An Insight check: a weapon or armour fit for your realm, or a point of Body from the labour. A perfect strike is better steel.

fx.t: The hammer works on you too.
The hammer works on you too.

fail.t: The metal will not take the shape. You salvage scrap, and a little pride.

cards.text: Pay 2 herbs and a beast core. A Spirit check: a battle talisman (it is used on its own in your next fight); a perfect inking is a five-thunder seal.

fail.t: The ink bleeds out of the lines. The paper is just paper again.

cards.text: Herbs +2. Sometimes a rich patch (+2 more), sometimes a snake in the leaves.

fx.t: A whole hollow of them, untouched.

pass.t: You stop mid-step above the coil of a viper and back away slowly.

fail.t: A viper in the leaves. It takes the ankle and leaves the herbs.

cards.text: Herbs +3; a one-in-five chance of a spirit herb (worth three herbs); the snakes are the same.

fx.t: Under a fallen log: a spirit herb, still glowing faintly.

pass.t: You stop mid-step above the coil of a viper and back away slowly.

fail.t: A viper in the leaves. It takes the ankle and leaves the herbs.

cards.text: Ore +2. Sometimes a seam (+1 more), sometimes the roof comes down on your shoulder.

fx.t: The seam runs on past where you thought it ended.

pass.t: You hear the creak and step back in time.

fail.t: The roof sheds a slab on your shoulder.

cards.text: Pay 2 herbs. Heal 40% HP, restore 30% MP, Cultivation +16, more with Insight. Granny Qingnang's cooking is medicine in a bowl.
Walk the roads: stones, herbs, ore or a lesson, and one time in five a fight fit for your realm.

fx.t: A peddler pays you to carry his pack to the next village.
A patch of herbs by the roadside, ignored by everyone but you.
A grey seam in a cutting: ore.
An old hermit lets you sit at his fire. He says nothing wise, and it helps.

cards.text: Walk farther: stones +18, herbs +3, ore +2 or a lesson; the fights are the same, but the loot is richer.

fx.t: A caravan master pays well for a spare pair of eyes.
A south-facing slope, thick with herbs.
A vein under a split boulder.
A travelling monk asks you one question and keeps your answer.

cards.text: Hunt a beast fit for your realm. On a win: +1 core, Cultivation +10, Notice +3. A loss leaves you wounded.
Hunt a beast fit for your realm. On a win: +2 cores, Cultivation +16, Notice +3.
Needs Qi Refining. A sky-severed vault: coin and ore, a carved lesson, a guardian, a trap or a real find. Notice +2.

fx.t: A collapsed vault: old coin and black ore under the dust.
A wall of carved sword-intent. You copy what your eyes can hold.
A pressure plate older than the sect. You remember the sound, mostly.
Behind a fallen lintel, a niche the thieves never found.

cards.text: Leave for Fallen-Star Town. Notice -8. A town is a good place to be nobody.

fx.t: The crowd closes round you like water. Nobody looks twice.

cards.text: Stones +10. Honest work, no risk, and it grows with your realm.

fx.t: Carrying, mending, counting: a day's wage and a sore back.

cards.text: Stones +16 and Cultivation +6. The foreman remembers your name.

fx.t: A regular place at the counting-table. The pay is better, and so is the sitting.

cards.text: A Speed check. Stones +25; caught, you lose HP and Notice +6; a perfect lift is +60 stones and a Verdant Qi Pill.

pass.t: Two fingers, a purse, a smile. Nobody looks round.

fail.t: A hand closes on your wrist. You leave a tooth in the street and the purse behind.

crit.t: The mark's sleeve held more than coin.

cards.text: Open the market: buy pills, talismans and materials; sell what you carry for a third of its price.

fx.t: The stalls are loud, and for once you have money to be ignored with.

cards.text: Needs a master (a sect, Mo Shan, or a bond with him). Rapport +1 with your master and Cultivation +14 or more; at rapport 3 a technique.

then.t: His one hand shows you the stroke that is on no page. You know whose handwriting it is.

cards.text: Spend the term with someone in your current place: rapport +1 with the person you would expect to find there.

then.t: You share a meal with Xiao He. She steals your last dumpling and calls it a tax.

fx.t: A woman with too many smiles buys you tea and asks nothing yet.
A stallholder tips you for keeping her company at the counter.
Yun Zhi shares her bench and her silence.
Xiao Heng is courteous, which is a way of keeping distance.

then.t: Granny Qingnang swears at you affectionately, which is rare.
Ye Wujin asks how you sleep. You find you tell him.

else.t: Nobody here is worth knowing yet.

cards.text: Spar a rival fit for your realm. Win: Cultivation +12 and a 60% chance of Body, Speed or Spirit +1. A loss costs HP and pride, not your life.

lose.t: You lose the bout and keep your bones. The bruises teach more than the win would have.

cards.text: Needs a sect. Pay 5 stones: three scrolls to choose a technique from, and half the time one of your cards is revised.

else.t: Every card you hold is already as good as the shelf can make it.

cards.text: Needs Su Jiu's trust. Pay 20 stones: she sells a hint (a fox's bargain, a pill, a quiet word at the registry), or, once, the thing she finds funniest.

fx.t: 'For you, a discount,' she says, and the smile means the opposite.
A pill pressed into your palm, still warm from her sleeve.
She leans over a ledger somewhere and smudges a line. Notice drops.

then.t: She laughs until she cries, then tells you why: you are not written down.

else.t: She has nothing new for you, and returns your coin in the shape of a joke.

cards.text: Su Jiu's deal. Pay 25 stones. Rapport +1 and one of: a lesson at the cost of a term of life, a lucky charm, Fortune +1, her own mask, or a bag of cores and herbs.

fx.t: 'My cut,' she says, and takes a term of your life as lightly as a coin.
A coin string, warm from her sleeve.
She whispers three numbers. Two of them come true.
Her own mask. 'Do not lose it,' she says, and for once means it.
A bag of things she could not sell.

cards.text: Heal 40% HP and restore 30% MP. Notice -6. Nobody is watching a sleeper.
Heal 60% HP and restore 50% MP. Notice -8. Cultivation +6.
Pay 2 herbs. Heal 60% HP and restore 20% MP.

fx.t: A poultice, a bandage, an hour of being told to keep still.

cards.text: Needs Notice 8 or more. Notice -15. Be nobody for a while.

fx.t: You do not go out, you do not speak up, and you leave no stories behind you.

cards.text: Pay 12 HP. Cultivation +6, and a 40% chance of Dao-heart +1. The monks' card: hunger is a teacher.

fx.t: Hunger strips the argument down to its bones. Dao-heart +1.
Hunger, and nothing else, which is also instruction.

cards.text: Light a stick of incense. Mostly calm and a little HP; sometimes a few stones, a herb, or Fortune +1.

fx.t: Incense smoke. Nothing answers, and you feel better for asking.
A coin left on the altar that somebody else prayed for.
A sprig of something fragrant caught in the hem of the altar-cloth.
Something in the smoke turns its face to you, just briefly.

cards.text: Needs Qi Refining. Pay 10 stones. Dao-heart +1 and Corruption -10. A still pool shows only what you carried there.

fx.t: You see yourself: tired, unfinished, and somehow not a stranger.

cards.text: Attempt the next realm. Chance 40% + Insight and Dao-heart; a breakthrough pill adds 20%. Failure wounds you, costs a quarter of your cultivation and may raise a heart-demon.

fx.t: You gather everything you have been and lean on the wall of the realm.
